headline: No. After two adversarial rounds the picture is worse, not better, than round 1: the only engine that has audited real code is the tool-less single-file development path (owner-adjudicated 13 defects in 317 claims, 4.1%; consensus indistinguishable from noise), and the seven-pass product pipeline cannot even ingest the target — a default `mmaudit scan` on ForestRoadVault maps 0 of 81 src files, once forced onto src/ it aborts inside its own regex Solidity parser with exit 2 and no report, and even with the authority chain closed its blind-review pass would dispatch zero model requests because 11 of 82 shards cannot build a context at any budget. Round 2 therefore moves ingestion/context construction ahead of the authority chain as priority 1.
answer_to_question: Not complete, and not moving toward 'best auditor, fully automated' at a measurable rate. Three facts decide it. (1) Governance measures ticket closure, not audits: completed_real_audits is pinned le=0 by the validator 26 days after the freeze while 72/113 tickets are COMPLETE, 721 Literal[False] declarations are in src, and 60 of the last 120 commits touch only the operator relay. (2) The product path has never called a real model (cli.py:6130-6145 passes no selection/refresh/pricing authority; pipeline.py:4092-4097 raises before OpenRouterClient is built) and, on the real Foundry tree, fails earlier and independently of that wall: lib/ exhausts max_files so src/ is never read (discovery.py:497-505), .DS_Store/symlink omissions abort sharding and the scanner workspace (sharding.py:914-933; base.py:1780-1789), the fallback parser drops every forge-fmt multi-line `contract X is` header (index.py:722-724; 15 of 23 core contracts index zero members) so the unconditional replay guard raises invariants.py:270 with no report, and the 48,000-byte chunker (context.py:2682) makes whole-file custody unsatisfiable for the 7 largest contracts so pipeline.py:7670-7683 fails the entire blind pass. (3) Quality is capped by architecture, not tuning: 0 of 527 external-call edges resolve to an entity on the product path (graphs.py:1930-1975), source_audit sees one file, the real run used one-file manifests, and 30 hand-written cross-file candidates yielded 8 owner-confirmed defects (5 medium) against 13 (6 medium) from 317 engine claims — while no ticket since the first quality numbers carries a recall/precision target and the qualification policy pins 17 thresholds at 1.0 'not measured'.
